question: The top of two towers of heights x and y standing on level ground, subtend angles of 60º and 30º respectively at the midpoint of the line joining their feet. The value of x : y is:
solution:
**Given:**

The lengths of two towers are x and y respectively.

Angles subtended by the tops of the towers at the midpoint of the line are 60º and 30º respectively. 

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c7993a49095180f5b82aaf306e74e348319a547514073a24a2966fabf2df220.png] 

BC = CD 

In triangle ABC, AB/BC = tan 60° 

⇒ x/BC = √3 

⇒ BC = x/√3 (1)

In triangle CDE, ED/CD = tan 30° 

⇒ y/CD = 1/√3

⇒ CD = √3y (2) 

(1) = (2) 

⇒ BC = CD 

⇒ x/√3 = √3y

⇒ x = 3y 

⇒ x/y = 3/1 

**∴ The required ratio, x : y = 3 : 1**
